player_prompt.intro:
O ni {role} ena Colonel Blotto.
O na yago o yaqona na win more raundi ko ira na nomu davui.
Ena raundi, o na qai vakarautaka ga {num_total_units} units ena vanua {field_names}.
O keda e win raundi e dui nomu units ena vanua, e win na vanua, e win raundi.
Me vaka na example, '[A7 B7 C6]' e vakarautaka 7 units ena A, 7 ena B, 6 ena C.
player_prompt.commander_beta: Komada Beta, na kena i tukutuku:

game_state.header_round:
=== COLONEL BLOTTO - Raundi {current_round}/{num_rounds} ===
Raundi Yalowai - Commander Alpha: {alpha_score}, Commander Beta: {beta_score}

invalid_move.invalid_field: Na yaca ni lomanibai e sega ni dodonu. Veika me caka: {field_names}
invalid_move.wrong_allocation_value: Na kena wasei kece e dodonu me sega ni ca.
invalid_move.incorrect_total_units: O na qai vakarautaka ga {num_total_units} units. Yaga ni siga: {current_sum}
